transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I came in because my thoughts and speech have been hard to organize. In my artist statements or meetings, I’ll start talking about textures, then suddenly I’m talking about budgets or meanings behind things, and people tell me they can’t follow what I’m trying to explain.
Over the past few weeks, have you noticed any periods where your mood felt unusually elevated, euphoric, or irritable, along with having much more energy than usual?

Yeah. There are stretches where I feel really lit up, like I’m unstoppable and every idea I have is brilliant. But then someone can make a small comment—like a collaborator questioning something—and I’ll snap at them way more than the situation really calls for.
Do you notice this disorganized, jumping-around thinking and speech even during times when your mood feels normal and not overly energized or irritable?

Yeah, I notice it even when I don’t feel especially up or irritable. I’ll be trying to explain something in a client note or a meeting, and I start with textures, then I’m suddenly talking about the budget or some secret meaning behind it. People tell me they can’t follow what I’m saying.
During the times when your mood feels normal—not elevated, irritable, or low—how long have these episodes of disorganized thinking and speech lasted, in days or weeks?
It’s been going on for weeks, even when my mood feels pretty normal. My statements and meeting notes will just jump from textures to budgets to these secret meanings, and people get lost.
Have you had any strong beliefs that people—like collaborators or clients—are plotting against you, spying on you, or trying to harm you in some way?

Not exactly plotting, but I can get convinced that stains or seams, or certain phrases in gallery emails, are meant specifically for me—like they’re instructions or warnings about my work. Even when someone gives me a normal explanation, it’s really hard to let that belief go.
Thinking back to when any of these changes—disorganized thinking, the belief that messages were meant for you, or the mood shifts—first started, about how many months ago did that begin?
About a year and two months ago, I think—around when I switched from community curation to doing independent installation work full-time.

Over this past year and two months, if you add up all the times you've felt that 'lit up' or irritable energy, roughly what fraction of that whole period would you say your mood was elevated or irritable, versus feeling more emotionally normal?
Looking back, I think the energized or irritable stretches have taken up more of the time than the calmer ones. The intensity changes, but overall it’s been more often than not.

final_diagnosis.reason: Patient reports a >1 year illness course with concurrent manic-like symptoms (elevated/irritable mood, increased energy, grandiosity, irritability) occupying the majority of the illness duration, alongside psychotic features (disorganized speech/thought and delusional beliefs of personal reference in stains, seams, and emails) that persist for weeks even when mood is euthymic. This combination—mood symptoms present for the majority of the illness plus psychotic symptoms (disorganized speech and delusions) occurring in the absence of prominent mood disturbance for at least 2 weeks—meets criteria for schizoaffective disorder, bipolar type, rather than a primary mood disorder with psychotic features (which requires psychotic symptoms only during mood episodes) or schizophrenia (which requires mood symptoms to be brief relative to total illness duration).
